Feature: Todo lifecycle
  As a user
  I want to create, complete, edit, and remove todos
  So that I can manage my task list

  Background:
    Given the app is loaded

  Rule: New todos

    Scenario: Creating a todo from input text
      When the user types "Buy milk" in the new-todo input and presses Enter
      Then a todo with title "Buy milk" exists in the list
      And the new-todo input is empty

    Scenario: Input is trimmed before creating a todo
      When the user types "  Buy milk  " in the new-todo input and presses Enter
      Then a todo with title "Buy milk" exists in the list

    Scenario: Empty or whitespace-only input creates no todo
      When the user types "   " in the new-todo input and presses Enter
      Then the todo list is empty

    Scenario: New todo input is focused on page load
      Then the new-todo input has focus

  Rule: Marking todos as complete

    Scenario: Clicking the checkbox marks a todo as completed
      Given a todo "Buy milk" exists
      When the user toggles the checkbox for todo "Buy milk"
      Then the todo "Buy milk" has the completed class

    Scenario: Unchecking a completed todo makes it active again
      Given a completed todo "Buy milk" exists
      When the user toggles the checkbox for todo "Buy milk"
      Then the todo "Buy milk" does not have the completed class

  Rule: Mark all as complete

    Scenario: Toggle-all checks all todos
      Given the following todos exist:
        | title        | completed |
        | Buy milk     | false     |
        | Walk the dog | false     |
      When the user clicks the toggle-all checkbox
      Then all todos are completed
      And the toggle-all checkbox is checked

    Scenario: Toggle-all unchecks when all are already complete
      Given the following todos exist:
        | title        | completed |
        | Buy milk     | true      |
        | Walk the dog | true      |
      When the user clicks the toggle-all checkbox
      Then all todos are active
      And the toggle-all checkbox is not checked

        | Buy milk     | true      |

      Then the toggle-all checkbox is not checked

  Rule: Destroying a todo

    Scenario: Clicking the destroy button removes the todo
      Given a todo "Buy milk" exists
      When the user destroys the todo "Buy milk"
      Then the todo "Buy milk" no longer exists
